texts.text: Contact parts such as cable lugs, compression joints, terminals, crimping tools, terminal blocks, and end sleeves
Cable protection such as tubings, braided sleeves, harness wraps, and wiring ducts
Cable identifications such as labels, markings, printers, and accessories
Large assortment of cable ties for diverse applications. All-plastic cable ties, stainless steel cable ties, accessories and cable tie installation tools.
Electrical Connection TechnologyBM GroupCompression cable lugs and joints, solderless terminals, terminal blocks and more.
Compression cable lugs and joints, solderless terminals, terminal blocks and more.
Diverse range of cable ties and accessories for indoor and outdoor applications. High UV resistance. Cable mountings and braided sleeves.
Cable Trunking SystemsElettrocanali®Trunking systems, accessories, junction boxes and more for practical, functional, and safe electrical installations.
Trunking systems, accessories, junction boxes and more for practical, functional, and safe electrical installations.
Cable ManagementEssentra®Cable ties, cable mounts, protection and accessories for fiber-optic cables and more.
Cable ties, cable mounts, protection and accessories for fiber-optic cables and more.
Cable glands, enclosures, and connectors for hazardous environments. Ideal for offshore applications and the oil and gas industry.
Cable AccessoriesHellermannTyton®Cable ties and cable mountings for industrial applications. Inside-serrated, outside-serrated, and metal cable ties.
Cable ties and cable mountings for industrial applications. Inside-serrated, outside-serrated, and metal cable ties.
Cable AccessoriesHeyco®Comprehensive cable assembly components, including cable glands, cable ties, clip fasteners and more.
Comprehensive cable assembly components, including cable glands, cable ties, clip fasteners and more.
High-quality cable glands and cable entry systems. For high-demand applications such as salt water, dust, oil and gas, or fluctuating temperatures.
Electrical Connection TechnologyKlauke®Cable lugs, compression joints, clamps, screw connectors, and crimping tools .
Cable lugs, compression joints, clamps, screw connectors, and crimping tools .
Ready-made components for electrical connection technology. Tubular cable lugs with and without inspection hole. 90° angle version.
Power ElementsMTCON®Innovative PCB technology press-fit connectors, such as power towers, power sockets, power edges, and power protectors.
Innovative PCB technology press-fit connectors, such as power towers, power sockets, power edges, and power protectors.
Comprehensive cable and wire management solutions, including cable ties, cable mounting products, cable identification, and heat shrink technology.
Cable ProtectionReikuComprehensive cable protection solutions, including tubing, connectors, heat and radiation protection.
Comprehensive cable protection solutions, including tubing, connectors, heat and radiation protection.
Easy to install and safe electrical enclosures for outdoor and indoor applications. Fire-resistant junction boxes, halogen-free junction boxes, and more.
The products listed here may not be available in all countries. In case of questions, please contact us.
